newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks buoyant, indices close at new highs.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks buoyant, indices close at new highs.

text.p: Madrid stock indices closed at new highs on Monday supported by a steady inflow of funds and swept up in the wake of other key stock market gains, strong bonds and a firm peseta, traders said.
The general index advanced 7.74 points, 1.70 pct, to 464.16. The Ibex-35 index of leading shares closed up 93.06 points, 1.77 pct, at 5,351.74.
"The market is very strong, there is a lot of money coming in and a strong correction at this stage is unlikely," said one trader.
Dealers said trading remained aggressive, with 96 billion pesetas traded. Repsol and Telefoncia accounted for 32 percent of this volume.
In the short-term, traders said a constant inflow of funds would support further gains and indices would likely make new highs.
Among individual stocks, Telefonica rose 35 pesetas to 3,275, while Repsol rose 160 pesetas to 5,670.
In the banking sector, Banco Popular advanced 5.14 percent, while BCH and Argentaria gained more than 1.2 percent.
